name: Dose-dense MVAC (ddMVAC) with growth factor support

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic ddMVAC (methotrexate, vinblastine, doxorubicin, cisplatin) backbone is not biomarker-restricted. Applies to urothelial carcinoma of the bladder (#57) and, as the same systemic regimen, upper-tract urothelial carcinoma (#58). Cisplatin-based, so requires cisplatin eligibility. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Bladder Cancer v3.2026, ddMVAC (DDMVAC) is preferred over standard MVAC based on category 1 evidence.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma; category 1 neoadjuvant option (3-6 cycles) for muscle-invasive bladder cancer

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate renal function and performance status (cisplatin-eligible)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, BL-G (Principles of Systemic Therapy): estimate GFR to assess cisplatin eligibility

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: myeloid growth factor (G-CSF) support is required (dose-dense schedule)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 154878-154890 (dose-dense/accelerated MVAC given q14 with growth factor support)

drugs.name: Methotrexate

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 44.5 (MVAC methotrexate 30 mg/m2 d1,15,22) with line 154880 (ddMVAC omits the day 15 and 22 methotrexate doses)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 44.5 (methotrexate 30 mg/m2) and line 154880: in dose-dense MVAC the methotrexate doses on days 15 and 22 are omitted, leaving methotrexate 30 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a compressed 14-day cycle.

drugs.name: vinBLAStine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 44.5 (MVAC vinblastine 3 mg/m2 d2,15,22) with line 154880 (ddMVAC omits the day 15 and 22 vinblastine doses)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 44.5 (vinblastine 3 mg/m2) and line 154880: in dose-dense MVAC the vinblastine doses on days 15 and 22 are omitted, leaving vinBLAStine 3 mg/m2 IV on day 2 of the 14-day cycle. ISMP tall-man (vinBLAStine).

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 44.5 (MVAC doxorubicin 30 mg/m2 d2) with line 154880 (doxorubicin dose remains the same in ddMVAC)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 44.5 (doxorubicin 30 mg/m2 day 2) and line 154880: doxorubicin dose is unchanged in dose-dense MVAC - DOXOrubicin 30 mg/m2 IV on day 2 of the 14-day cycle. ISMP tall-man (DOXOrubicin). Cumulative lifetime cap is the conventional anthracycline ceiling (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2), not a dose from Table 44.5.

drugs.name: CISplatin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 44.5 (MVAC cisplatin 70 mg/m2 d2) with line 154880 (cisplatin dose remains the same in ddMVAC)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 44.5 (cisplatin 70 mg/m2 day 2) and line 154880: cisplatin dose is unchanged in dose-dense MVAC - CISplatin 70 mg/m2 IV on day 2 of the 14-day cycle. ISMP tall-man (CISplatin). Requires vigorous IV hydration; monitor nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, and peripheral neuropathy.

regimen.cycles: Neoadjuvant: 3 to 6 cycles (per DeVita); every 14 days with mandatory growth factor support. Metastatic: continued per response/tolerance.

premedications.name: Cisplatin hydration and antiemetics
premedications.notes: vigorous pre- and post-cisplatin IV hydration; high-emetic-risk antiemetic prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support is MANDATORY on every 14-day cycle (dose-dense schedule) per DeVita 12th ed. (lines 154878-154890) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v3.2026 (DDMVAC with growth factor support).
Cisplatin: mandatory vigorous IV hydration; monitor and replace magnesium/potassium.
Antiemetics: high emetic risk (cisplatin) - use a high-emetic-risk prophylaxis regimen.
Track cumulative doxorubicin dose (anthracycline cardiotoxicity ceiling).
Monitor for cisplatin nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, and peripheral neuropathy; mucositis (methotrexate).

doseModificationRules.text: Reassess cisplatin eligibility if renal function declines; consider a carboplatin-based regimen. Do not substitute carboplatin for cisplatin in the perioperative setting (BL-G).
Assess cardiac function and review continuation as cumulative doxorubicin approaches the 450 mg/m2 warn / 550 mg/m2 hard ceiling.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Table 44.5 (standard MVAC doses: methotrexate 30, vinblastine 3, doxorubicin 30, cisplatin 70 mg/m2); lines 154878-154890 (ddMVAC = MVAC compressed to 14 days, day 15/22 methotrexate and vinblastine omitted, doxorubicin and cisplatin unchanged, growth factor support; 3-6 neoadjuvant cycles)

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (BL-G 2 of 8): DDMVAC preferred over standard MVAC (category 1) - better tolerated and more effective in advanced disease; traditional MVAC dose/schedule no longer recommended; DDMVAC with growth factor support.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for dose-dense MVAC (ddMVAC) with growth factor support in urothelial carcinoma - bladder (#57) and upper-tract (#58). Doses are sourced to DeVita 12th ed. Table 44.5 (methotrexate 30, vinblastine 3, doxorubicin 30, cisplatin 70 mg/m2) with the dose-dense modification explicitly stated at lines 154878-154890: MVAC compressed to a 14-day cycle, the day 15 and 22 methotrexate and vinblastine doses omitted (leaving methotrexate day 1, vinblastine day 2), doxorubicin and cisplatin unchanged (day 2), given with mandatory myeloid growth factor support for 3-6 neoadjuvant cycles. Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Bladder Cancer v3.2026 (BL-G) establish that DDMVAC is preferred over standard MVAC (category 1) with growth factor support. ISMP tall-man applied (vinBLAStine, DOXOrubicin, CISplatin). The doxorubicin cumulative ceiling (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2) is the conventional anthracycline limit, not a dose from Table 44.5. Cisplatin hydration and nephro/oto/neuro monitoring emphasized. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
